set.requirements: Licences required from 1 Aug 2023 for 8 gallium and 6 germanium items (metal, GaN, Ga2O3, GaAs, GeO2, GeCl4 etc.) [CLM-0344]. Notice 2023 No. 23 was repealed on 1 Dec 2024 and the items moved into the unified Dual-Use Items Export Control List. China produced ~60% of germanium and ~90% of gallium in 2022 [CLM-0345].

Para. 1 bans dual-use exports to US military users/uses (still in force); para. 2 in principle denies Ga, Ge, Sb, superhard exports to the US and tightens graphite end-use review, with liability for third-country transfers. Para. 2 suspended 9 Nov 2025 to 27 Nov 2026 by Announcement 2025 No. 72.

Licence for foreign-made items with ≥0.1% Chinese-origin rare-earth content or made with Chinese rare-earth technology (due 1 Dec 2025); Chinese-origin listed items from 9 Oct 2025; case-by-case review for ≤14nm logic / ≥256-layer memory end uses; presumption of denial for military and listed users. Whole notice suspended 7 Nov 2025 to 10 Nov 2026 by Announcement 2025 No. 70.

Anti-dumping case on US commodity interface and gate-driver ICs at 40nm and above (HS 85423990), petition by Jiangsu SIA; POI 2024, injury 2022-2024; due by 13 Sep 2026, extendable 6 months; questionnaires Oct 2025, no later notice found; status unknown. The US said China would terminate such probes.
